120	theorem eq_of_relPicDeg_eq (x y : relPic (P1.asOver k) (overSpec k K))
121	    (h : relPicDeg K x = relPicDeg K y) : x = y := by
122	  have hdiv : relPicDeg K (x * y⁻¹) = 0 := by
123	    rw [relPicDeg_mul, h, ← relPicDeg_mul, mul_inv_cancel, relPicDeg_one]
